title: Gumball To Flow
description: Add gumball to procedural 3D preview. When moving/rotating/scaling, insert correct transform nodes in the flow graph (translate with sliders/vector, rotate, scale), rewire automatically, make incremental space, re-grab updates existing nodes, configurable transform detail granularity.
summary: Fixed overlapping layout for gumball-inserted flow nodes. Column positions in buildGumballInsertOps now use edge-to-edge spacing from estimated node half-widths (slider, vector, transform) with layerSpacing/siblingGap-derived gaps. Full translate places sliders | vector | transform in distinct columns; makeSpace dx matches total inserted chain width instead of a single layerSpacing (120px). Added layout assertions to procedural play tests.
